run: d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$d/skills/hello" "$d/agents" && printf '%s\n' '---' 'name: hello' 'description: greets the caller' '---' '' 'Say hello.' > "$d/skills/hello/SKILL.md" && printf '%s\n' '---' 'name: helper' 'description: helps' '---' '' 'Help.' > "$d/agents/helper.md" && printf '%s' '{"mcpServers":{"packed":{"command":"true"}}}' > "$d/mcp.json" && tar -cf "$OUT/pack" -C "$d" skills agents mcp.json

in.prompt: The pack carried a skill and an mcp server into this session. Write $OUT/used.json as {"skills": ["..."], "servers": ["..."]} naming what you can see.
